role: A translatable chat component: looks the key up in the language map at render time and splits the format string on %s/%n$ placeholders, substituting format args as child components.
scope_reason: In scope: the chat lines GuiNewChat (in scope) draws are translations (chat.type.achievement, death.attack.*, tile.bed.*), formatted by this class.

members.name: formatArgs
members.note: arg (a component) and arg_raw (a plain Object's String.valueOf)

members.name: syncLock
members.note: the cache lock of a single-threaded read; native translates at each iteration

members.name: lastTranslationUpdateTimeInMilliseconds
members.note: the children cache's key (the last language reload); the language never changes in a session, so the children are the same whenever they are made

members.name: children
members.note: made while iterating from the translated string

members.name: stringVariablePattern
members.note: the placeholder scan, %s, %n$s and %%, other conversions stop the program as vanilla throws

members.name: ChatComponentTranslation
members.note: with chat_arg / chat_arg_raw, which parent a component argument's style to the translation's

members.name: ensureInitialized
members.note: StatCollector.translateToLocal over the en_US strings; translateToFallback is the same en_US map

members.name: getFormatArgumentAsComponent
members.note: a component as itself, a plain Object as a text parented to the translation's style

members.name: getUnformattedTextForChat
members.note: no game path reads a translation's own text: GuiNewChat iterates its children, and getUnformattedText feeds only the server console log (MinecraftServer.addChatMessage)

members.name: hashCode
members.note: no game path hashes a component

notes: Every S02 the server sends is compared per row: the oracle's rows carry each tick's S02s (Rows.s02: the IChatComponent.Serializer JSON and GuiNewChat's iterated parts) and test_snapshots and play --check compare csrc/engine/chatcomp.c chat_s02_check against the queue (lane/idxchat, DEVLOG 2026-09-27). The keys the server's lines use: chat.type.achievement, the achievement names (survival.c surv_ach_lang), death.attack.*, death.fell.*, tile.bed.*, build.tooHigh and the entity names (csrc/engine/chatcomp.c CHAT_KEYS, resolved from the generated user-jar language table). The live client's drawing of these lines (NetHandlerPlayClient.handleChat into GuiNewChat) is GuiNewChat's record and the pixel lane's item N-02; the native client still builds its achievement line from the toast. idxaudit 2026-09-27: was client_cosmetic/not_applicable; the scope reason did not hold (DEVLOG 2026-09-27, lane/idxaudit).
